title: Hong Kong-based Qupital, which offers cross-border ecommerce financing to SMEs, raised a $300M Series C led by M Capital, as it weighs a possible IPO (FinTech Global)
summary: FinTech Global: Hong Kong-based Qupital, which offers cross-border ecommerce financing to SMEs, raised a $300M Series C led by M Capital, as it weighs a possible IPO — Qupital, an AI-driven trade finance platform focused on cross-border e-commerce, has raised $300m in combined new capital …
